title: Additional RG related requirements for IP address allocation

entities.name: IPv6 PDU session types
entities.description: IPv6 PDU session type or IPv4v6 PDU session type selected for IP address allocation.

entities.name: Router Advertisement with Managed flag zero
entities.description: Router Advertisement Message with Managed address configuration flag set to zero, triggering stateless address autoconfiguration.

entities.name: Router Advertisement with Managed flag one
entities.description: Router Advertisement Message with Managed address configuration flag set to one, triggering DHCPv6 address acquisition.

entities.name: IPv6 stateless address autoconfiguration
entities.description: Procedure where 5G-RG/W-AGF obtains /64 IPv6 prefix via stateless address autoconfiguration as per RFC 4862.

entities.name: Stateless DHCPv6
entities.description: Procedure for obtaining IPv6 configuration parameters via stateless DHCPv6 as per RFC 8415.

entities.name: Stateful DHCPv6
entities.description: Procedure for obtaining IPv6 address via DHCPv6 Identity association for non-temporary addresses option as per RFC 8415.

entities.name: DHCPv6 prefix delegation
entities.description: Procedure where 5G-RG/W-AGF acts as Requesting Router to obtain IPv6 prefixes using DHCPv6 Identity association for prefix delegation option.

entities.name: DHCP options
entities.description: DHCPv6 options including Rapid commit option and OPTION_ORO with OPTION_PD_EXCLUDE option code.

entities.name: ACS information via DHCP
entities.description: Procedure for 5G-RG to obtain ACS information via DHCP as specified in BBF TR-069 or TR-369.

relations.description: IPv6 PDU session types condition the reception of Router Advertisement with Managed flag zero.
Router Advertisement with Managed flag zero establishes IPv6 stateless address autoconfiguration procedure.
Router Advertisement with Managed flag zero may establish stateless DHCPv6 procedure.
Router Advertisement with Managed flag zero may establish DHCPv6 prefix delegation procedure.
Router Advertisement with Managed flag one establishes stateful DHCPv6 procedure.
Router Advertisement with Managed flag one may establish DHCPv6 prefix delegation procedure.
DHCPv6 prefix delegation procedure may include DHCP options like Rapid commit and OPTION_ORO.
ACS information via DHCP procedure involves DHCP options as per BBF specifications.
